column1: # Packages the -race legs of ci/check_go.sh do not run (CHAOS-11413). The test legs still run each one once, without -race.
# Row: package<TAB>class<TAB>witness<TAB>reason. Key = path relative to the module root. Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates.
#   class none, witness -: the package's own files and its test files import NOTHING from this module (not even a testdata, underscore
#     or nested-module path), import only the standard-library packages in racescope's stdlibAllowed (no context, runtime, reflect, sync,
#     net, os/exec ...), and hold no go statement, channel, select, timer goroutine, t.Parallel, dot import, cgo or non-Go source,
#     go:linkname, plugin import, or function converted to an interface or passed to a call outside racescope's pureCallees. Proven by
#     internal/cigates/racescope, which fails when a listed package gains one (CHAOS-11413, acp trivially sound rule).
# A package leaves this file as soon as it needs a -race run. internal/providersync, internal/cigates/testshard and
# internal/testsupport/goldenscan/treegate stay in -race (treegate imports goldenscan, whose CheckTree starts worker goroutines).
